config.title: FUNDA — Paginated Data Table

intro.title: FUNDA — Paginated Data Table
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Paginated Data Table that fetches server-side pages of records, exposes page and sort controls, and synchronises the current page and sort order into the URL as query parameters. The table state is shareable and bookmark-able — refreshing the page returns to the same view. Data is fetched reactively by combining query parameter observables with switchMap into an HTTP request. A loading skeleton replaces the table rows during fetch, and results are cached with shareReplay to avoid duplicate requests when navigating back.
intro.usecase: Paginated data tables are the backbone of admin panels, CRM systems, financial dashboards, and analytics tools. The URL-as-state pattern is critical for enterprise UX — users share links, use the browser back button, and bookmark specific table views.

objectives: Read page and sort query parameters from ActivatedRoute.queryParams as an Observable and combine them with combineLatest
Use switchMap to trigger an HTTP request whenever the combined query parameters change, cancelling stale requests
Navigate to updated query params on page or sort change using queryParamsHandling:'merge' to preserve other params
Display a loading state and empty state using the async pipe's structural directives without any component-level subscription
Apply shareReplay(1) in the data service so navigating back to this route does not re-fire the same HTTP request
Implement a sort header that cycles through ascending, descending, and unsorted states and encodes the result in the URL
Test the component by providing a mock ActivatedRoute with queryParams as a BehaviorSubject and verifying HTTP call triggers
